open_items: Only 1 round recorded. Pulse 2.0 gives $6M as total capital raised since 2025 founding, not the seed alone, so amount left null; other outlets date the announcement May 27, 2026 (search summary only). One search summary says Unshackled led; the fetched page names no lead.

TechCrunch 2023 names Fund III investments Masa Finance, Cache Energy, Formally but with no round amounts or dates. Cache Energy rounds (Research Park pages, 2023 and 2024) do not name Unshackled; third-party trackers do.

HQ not on fetched pages (search results disagree: San Francisco vs Palo Alto). The $3.5M (2014) fund lead and Bay Area not verified. Check size not stated (Eighteen150 program: $150,000 for 10% per TechCrunch). Fund III date is TechCrunch article date.
Immigrant-founder focus is explicit; Indian founders specifically not stated. Homepage claims 300+ immigration filings.
